For the local quadratic family `S[y]=1/2 int (c0*y^2+c1*(y')^2+c2*(y'')^2)d ell`, the first variation at `y0(ell)=delta ell` on node-vanishing perturbations is `c0 int y0*p + c1 delta (p(L)-p(0)) + c2 int y0''*p''`.  Because node-vanishing gives `p(0)=p(L)=0` and `y0''=0`, derivative-only terms are stationary, but an unforced mass term requires `int ell*p=0` for all node-vanishing `p`, which is false.  The finite polynomial witness family `R(ell)*ell^k` supplies explicit nonzero mass moments while preserving zero derivative-only residuals.
